content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on contract basis for a period of 1(one) year. No other allowance shall be admissible within the service tenure, except the Salary or Honorarium. Casual leave of 1 (one) day for every completed month i.e. 12 days for 1 complete year with pay is admissible. Woman employees are entitled to maternity leave of 180 days for 2(two) occasions with pay.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Tripura Employees State Insurance Society Insurance Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Download the terms and conditions and application format from the official website www.labour.tripura.gov.in or tripura.gov.in. Fill out the prescribed application format completely. Prepare a duly filled API calculation sheet and self-attested copies of necessary documents including age proof, educational qualification, and caste certificate. Submit the application by hand or post to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Tripura Employees' State Insurance Society, Shram Bhawan, Office Lane, Agartala. Ensure the application reaches the office within 16/11/2026.

faq.question: Q1. Is this recruitment on a permanent basis or contract?
faq.answer: The recruitment is purely on a contract basis for a period of 1(one) year.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC and ST candidates specifically for the Accountant post, while upper age limits range up to 65 or 70 years depending on the post without mention of general relaxations except where stated.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications or preferences mentioned in the notice?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to medical professionals who have worked in the Tripura Health Service, Govt. of Tripura or any ESI Hospital/Dispensary for the Insurance Medical Officer post, and similarly for Pharmacist and Auxiliary Nurse Midwife posts involving candidates who worked in Tripura Health Service, Govt. of Tripura or ESI hospitals/dispensaries.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose a duly filled API calculation sheet and self-attested necessary documents of their age proof, educational qualification, and cast certificate.

faq.question: Q5. How is the candidate performance assessed for selection?
faq.answer: The engagement is made through a process of Walk in Interview against Academic performance Index carrying 100 marks and Interview carrying 10 marks, with an additional 5 marks given to the Degree holder in Pharmacy.
